content.comment_body: Has anyone been able to locate these yet?
When creating a message block, select the symbol '°C'.

analysis.insight_summary: The discussion focuses on challenges users face in locating or inserting special symbols (like '°C') while preparing message blocks in [company_name] software. Users express difficulty finding these symbols, pointing to an unclear interface or limited search capabilities for symbols. This reveals an issue with the ease of discovering and utilizing frequently needed symbols.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate straightforward and convenient access to commonly used special symbols when composing message blocks in the software.
